physics_and_numerics.geometry: Original fresh nested angular topology; collocation ray is normalized mean of parent angular corner rays. OriginalCPU radial roots put each cell centre on Roche equipotential. Base-quarter order4Duffy true-area integration and exact mirroring. No scalar mesh correction. Cell normals/pointgravity evaluated at those same true centres.
physics_and_numerics.gravity_and_thermal: OriginalCPU analyticgradient, SI scalingG*M_primary/a² for both stars, originalgravity-darkening/polar-reference and unspotted renormalization on new curved cell areas. Device composes existing pointgravity and area-weightedthermal kernels with original renormalization. Repeated point-selector connectivity never defines area/normals; cornergravity averages discarded. Fresh intrinsic temperature arrays remain device inputs through irradiation/emission.
physics_and_numerics.irradiation: Original full-donor coupling formulas/cooler-first sequential iteration/bolometricLDprefix and visibility rules on new centres/normals/areas. CPUreference uses original primitive tiles, GPU uses existing tiled engine. Finitecollocation IR, not exact continuous illumination or proof of reflectedenergy closure.
physics_and_numerics.radiance: Fresh originalLD and originalpassband Planck/Simpson conventions. CPUreferenceoriginalradiance/flux, devicefreshBB atreflecteddeviceT. CK04explicitoriginalCPU radiance/LD with unchanged interpolation/unsupported semantics. Opticaldepth/samebandLD normalization and originaldistance/thirdlight/max/mean mappings retained.
physics_and_numerics.common_quadrature: All field levels share actual same clipped packet within each batch. Checked nested positive-cone ancestry; independent reference/GPU packetdigests and traces identical. Piecewise-constant collocation field values remain finite; boundary/partition refinement separate. No scalar-correction parameter; provenancecorrection_level=-1/curvature_fields=1.
physics_and_numerics.method_vs_parity: CPUparity applies originalCPU equations to new curved fields/integration, not unchanged originalfaceted wholecurves. A separate shared-packet legacyfield2→curvaturefield2 comparison labels this as a numerical method change. All619baseline files and originalCPU/default/fallback semantics unchanged.
physics_and_numerics.domain: Circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2],spin[.5,1.5],inner radius1e-6..0.25 plus explicit geometry/numerics. Fieldlevels0-3/commonlevelmax(fieldlevels)..3 with40000faces/starcap;1-4uniquefieldlevels,1-8bands,1-128phases. Existing boundary/node and reflectionpair/iteration caps retained. Resource/unsupportederrors abort outside prior penalties; no silentcoarsening/prior cuts. Nodecap is not peakmemory.
physics_and_numerics.limits: Order4curved cell area and pointcollocated finitegravity/thermal/IR/radiance, not continuouslyevaluated fields at everyobserverquadpoint. Straightboundarychords and empiricaltopologyprobes persist. Finitepair passes do not certify uncomputed field/boundary limits, reflectedenergy balance or continuum posterior.

validation_and_science.controls: Originalgradient and thermal/reflection/radiance fields percomponent, original forceSIunits, independentangular32Brentarea, cellpotentialresidual, intrinsiccurvedmeasureluminosityclosure, uniformβ0/noIR cell-levelindependence, zeroalbedo exactintrinsicpreservation, FP64disable rejection, originalCPUbefore/after and changedphysics/response/source identity. q/spin/log/sqrtLD/CK04/smallocculter and full partial/total/contact curves.
validation_and_science.gates: Prior3e-13relative raw/componentzeroabsolute and3e-13/2e-12normalized gates unchanged. Newfield arrays3e-13/64eps; originaldensity1e-6absolute. Accuracyseparate: nominalsigma1e-4, enclosureD<=0.1 independentlyln_f. Data-dependentfiniteLLboundincludesresidual cross term. No tolerance/oracle loosening.
validation_and_science.paired_observations: Base/changed/JD originalphysicalserializers/constraints/priors/phases/reducers/repeats/thirdlight/mean/noise through matched callbacks. Each proposal has a coarsecompletecomparison and a separatelyboundedfinecompletecomparison; matching source/proposal/physicalphase signatures enforced. Coarsecontrols explicitly omit ownboundaryqualification. Finepreflight uses saved fullcoarsecurves, and both costs/walls counted. No discardedprior or hiddencachedphysicalprediction.
validation_and_science.inference: Passingfinitefield orboundarydistance doesnotensure negligible accumulatedLLerror. No registeredcurvaturefieldfitter/sampler, optimizedfit,biasrecovery,mixing,convergence orESS/secclaim.
validation_and_science.next: Address remaining eclipseboundary and accumulatedlikelihood error with independentcurved-field controls before1e-4physicalfit/MCMC qualification.

timing_conditions.batches: Matched same-unit reference/GPU constructors plus all freshcurved field models, CPUroots/areas/ancestry/clipping/hash, original ordevicephysics, alltransfers and raw/normalized/componenthostcurves. Levels/outputcount explicitlyrecorded. CPUaffinity0-15/Nice10/threads1/FP64. Compilation incurred included; code/response/shape caches canwarm. Singlemeasurements, notdistributions.
timing_conditions.callbacks: Each completecomparisoncallback includesphysicalserialization/constraints/constructor/prior/originalprediction/density and allrequestedcomparisoncurves; finecurve passes originalmapping. Mapping-onlysamecandidateoracles are outsidecallbacktimer, nottimed as freshsynthesis. Not ordinarysinglemodelMCMCthroughput.
timing_conditions.paired_costs: Coarse andfine invocations each independentlycheckpointed/restored and bounded. Paired summaries sum allcallback andstudywalls; commands includePython/import startup. Allocation probes/checkpoint/restoration separate. CPUdevelopmenttimings excluded from matched evidence.
timing_conditions.bridges: Truegeometry/area/adaptation/clipping and originalLD/tablepreparation remainCPUbridges. No allGPU orqualifiedfitting/MCMC/ESSaccelerationclaim.
